suggestion.submittedBy: entropy-reducer@1 (compiled for claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh, claude-cli-print) - non-authoritative
suggestion.problemOrOpportunity: The compiled Entropy Reducer grants four read-only delegate lenses and will not compile without the delegates resource. Both pinned review routes deny delegation, however. Every review and refutation therefore carries, and describes, a fan-out it cannot perform, and it works the lens briefs serially.
suggestion.scope: Make the compiler, the transport profile and the receipt agree by choosing one route. Either admit a read-only delegate tool on the claude-cli-print review route under the same --restricted confinement and record delegates used, or stop compiling fan-out-lens for routes without a delegate tool and render the lens briefs as the reviewer's checklist. In both cases, add a fixture test that every effect family the compiled envelope grants maps to something the pinned transport admits.
affectedUsers: the operator reading Entropy Reducer receipts
the reviewer actor following the compiled Program
maintainers of the loadout and transport profiles
suggestion.expectedValue: The residue and receipts would describe the episode that actually ran. If delegation is admitted, census breadth can run in parallel within the existing four-delegate ceiling. The test would catch later drift between grants and routes.
suggestion.uncertainty: It has not been probed whether a delegate tool can be admitted under --restricted without widening file access. Whether serial lens work loses coverage compared with delegates is unmeasured.
risks: Admitting delegation adds cost and a second confinement surface to check
Dropping the support changes the compiled semantic hash and regenerates the residue and fixtures
alternatives: Keep the current routes and record 'delegates: 0 of 4, route denies' as a receipt field
Keep the support but mark it route-conditional in the residue
duplicationHints: REVIEW-002 result envelope noted the same absence without a finding
suggestion.urgencyRationale: Low: it misdescribes each review and refutation episode but blocks nothing. It is cheapest to settle the next time the loadout is regenerated.
